definition: unable to pay what you owe
hook: Bankrupt is not about money running out. It is about furniture being destroyed.
modernAnchor: A shuttered shop, a final notice, a company that cannot pay. We call it bankrupt.
journey: Moneylenders in medieval Italian cities worked outdoors, each one at a bench in the marketplace. The bench was a banca, and that is where the word bank comes from.
The bench was the business. It was the counter, the shopfront and the proof you were still trading.
When a lender could not pay what he owed, his bench was broken in front of the market. Banca rotta, broken bench, named the act and the man it was done to.
French and English took the phrase and welded it into one word. The public smashing is gone, but the furniture is still in there.
